scenario: Uber ETA 在新路修好后悄悄失准、欺诈模型在骗子换招后照旧,离线指标却一切正常、没有告警响起。
scenario_en: Uber ETA quietly drifts after new roads open and a fraud model rots as fraudsters shift tactics, yet offline metrics look fine and no alarm fires.
q: ML 生产监控为什么是持续学习的前提，它由哪四层组成？
q_en: Why is production monitoring a precondition for continual learning, and what four layers make it up?
why: 所有再训练策略都假设你能先「检测到退化」；检测不到，模型就悄悄腐烂。监控由四层互相支撑：数据漂移、概念漂移、预测监控、告警。
why_en: Every retraining strategy assumes you can first detect degradation, or the model silently rots, so monitoring stacks four interdependent layers: data drift, concept drift, prediction monitoring, and alerting.
diagram:
flowchart TB DD["数据漂移
P(X) 变"] --> AL["告警"] CD["概念漂移
P(Y·X) 变"] --> AL PM["预测监控
输出分布"] --> AL AL --> R["再训练/回滚/降级"]
options: 监控只是上线后的可选装饰,模型质量在训练阶段就已经定好了
再训练都假设先能检测退化;四层:数据漂移、概念漂移、预测监控、告警
监控就是记录日志,唯一目的是出事之后追责和还原时间线
四层其实是数据/模型/服务/网络这类基础设施监控,盯的是 CPU、内存等硬件资源
options_en: Monitoring is optional post-launch decoration; model quality is already fixed at training time.
Retraining assumes you can detect degradation first; the four layers are data drift, concept drift, prediction monitoring, and alerting.
Monitoring is just logging, whose only purpose is post-incident blame and timeline reconstruction.
The four layers are actually data/model/service/network infrastructure monitoring, watching CPU, memory and other hardware resources.
optionExplanations: 监控不是装饰，是持续学习的前提：没有检测就无从触发再训练，模型只会悄悄退化。
对；四层从数据到概念到预测再到告警层层兜住退化信号，是本课的核心心智模型。
日志追责只是副产品，监控真正要做的是实时发现分布/映射/输出的退化。
这四层是数据科学层面的漂移与告警，不是硬件监控层。
optionExplanations_en: Monitoring is not decoration but a precondition for continual learning: without detection you cannot trigger retraining and the model just degrades silently.
Correct — the four layers catch degradation signals from data to concept to prediction to alerting, the lesson's core mental model.
Log-based blame is a byproduct; monitoring's real job is real-time detection of distribution/mapping/output degradation.
These four are data-science drift and alerting layers, not hardware monitoring tiers.

termDefinitions.meaning: 输入特征的分布；数据漂移就是它随时间变化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: P(X) is the distribution of input features; data drift is P(X) changing over time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给定输入时标签的条件分布，即输入到输出的映射；概念漂移是它变了。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: P(Y|X) is the conditional distribution of the label given inputs — the input-to-output mapping; concept drift is P(Y|X) changing.

scenario: 夏天到秋天,交通流量的输入特征分布明显变了,但「给定这些输入、路况预测该是多少」的映射关系并没有变。
scenario_en: From summer to autumn, the input traffic-feature distribution clearly shifts, but the mapping from those inputs to the predicted outcome has not changed.
q: 这属于哪种漂移，用什么来检测最合适？
q_en: Which kind of drift is this, and what detects it best?
why: 这是数据漂移(data drift)：输入分布 P(X) 变了、映射 P(Y|X) 未必变。检测靠逐特征比对参考(训练)窗口 vs 滚动服务窗口的分布,主力方法是 PSI 和 KS 检验。
why_en: This is data drift — P(X) shifts while P(Y|X) may not — detected by comparing each feature's reference (training) window against a rolling serving window, mainly via PSI and the KS test.
tradeoff: 查数据漂移(逐特征比分布) vs 查概念漂移(需标签看映射)
options: 概念漂移;映射变了,得靠在线精度/召回下降来检测,不是比输入分布
数据漂移;用 PSI/KS 比参考窗口与滚动服务窗口的分布
预测漂移;只看输出分布随时间的变化,不比对输入特征
标签延迟;真标签没回来,只能用代理标签近似检测
options_en: Concept drift; the mapping changed, so you catch it from a drop in online precision or recall, not by comparing input distributions.
Data drift; use PSI or KS to compare the reference window against the rolling serving window.
Prediction drift; you only watch how the output distribution moves, never comparing input features.
Label delay; true labels have not come back, so you approximate with proxy labels.
whenOtherWins: 若输入分布没变、但同样输入现在对应不同结果(如 UI 改版后 CTR 骤降),那才是概念漂移,要靠标签驱动的指标来抓。
whenOtherWins_en: If inputs are unchanged but the same input now yields a different outcome (CTR collapses after a UI redesign), that is concept drift, caught by label-driven metrics.
optionExplanations: 概念漂移是映射 P(Y|X) 变,本题明说映射未变、只有输入分布变,不符。
对；输入分布 P(X) 变正是数据漂移,逐特征比参考 vs 服务窗口的分布是标准打法。
预测漂移只看输出,而本题证据在输入特征分布上,应直接查输入。
标签延迟是标签时效问题,与本题「输入分布变了」的检测对象无关。
optionExplanations_en: Concept drift is the mapping P(Y|X) changing; here the mapping is stated unchanged with only inputs shifting, so it does not fit.
Correct — a shifting input distribution P(X) is exactly data drift, and comparing each feature's reference vs serving window is the standard approach.
Prediction drift looks only at outputs, but the evidence here is in the input feature distribution, so check inputs directly.
Label delay is a timing issue, unrelated to detecting the shifted input distribution in this case.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时的数据分布快照,作为对照基线去比对当前服务窗口。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A reference window is a snapshot of the training-time distribution used as a baseline to compare against the current serving window.

termDefinitions.term: rolling serving window / 滚动服务窗口
termDefinitions.meaning: 线上最近一段时间的输入分布,随时间滑动,用来和参考窗口比漂移。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A rolling serving window is the recent live input distribution that slides over time, compared to the reference window to detect drift.

scenario: 用 PSI 逐特征监控数据漂移,某特征算出 PSI = 0.3。
scenario_en: Monitoring per-feature data drift with PSI, one feature comes out at PSI = 0.3.
q: PSI 怎么算、阈值怎么读、这个 0.3 意味着要做什么？
q_en: How is PSI computed, how are its thresholds read, and what does 0.3 mean to do?
why: PSI 按分箱累加 Σ(实际比例−期望比例)·ln(实际/期望),衡量服务分布偏离训练分布多远。经验阈值 <0.1 无、0.1–0.25 中度、>0.25 显著,所以 0.3 要排查或再训练。
why_en: PSI (Population Stability Index) is the sum over bins of (actual minus expected) times ln(actual/expected), symmetric; empirically under 0.1 is no shift, 0.1 to 0.25 moderate, and above 0.25 significant, so 0.3 means this feature drifted significantly and needs action.
options: PSI 是模型精度指标,0.3 就是准确率 30%,低于基线才需要行动
按分箱累加 Σ(实际−期望)·ln(实际/期望);0.3 超过 0.25 阈值=显著漂移
PSI 越大代表分布越稳定,0.3 属于高分,说明这个特征很健康
PSI 只对连续特征有效,类别特征必须换成卡方检验;而且分箱越少结果越准,建议只分 3 箱
options_en: PSI is a model-accuracy metric, so 0.3 means 30% accuracy and you act only below baseline.
Sum over bins of (actual minus expected) times ln(actual/expected); 0.3 clears the 0.25 line, so it is significant drift.
A bigger PSI means a more stable distribution, so 0.3 is a high score and this feature is healthy.
PSI only works on continuous features and categorical ones must switch to a chi-square test, and fewer bins are more accurate so three bins is best.

termDefinitions.meaning: 总体稳定性指数:按分箱累加 (实际比例−期望比例)·ln(实际/期望),衡量分布漂移,对称。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PSI (Population Stability Index) sums (actual minus expected) times ln(actual/expected) over bins to measure distribution drift, and is symmetric.

optionExplanations: 把 PSI 当成准确率是常见误解——它是分布漂移的统计量，跟模型精度无关，0.3 不对应任何准确率数字。
对；公式和三档阈值都对上了，0.3 落在显著区，该去排查或考虑再训练。
说反了——PSI 越大代表分布离参考窗口越远，0.3 是明显漂移的信号，不是稳定。
分箱不是越少越准，关键是分箱要固定一致；而且 PSI 类别、连续特征都能用，不是只对连续有效。
optionExplanations_en: PSI is not an accuracy metric — it measures distribution shift, so 0.3 has nothing to do with a 30% accuracy figure.
Right — the formula and threshold bands line up, and 0.3 lands in the action zone, so investigate or retrain.
Backwards — a higher PSI means the distribution has drifted further from the reference, so 0.3 signals real drift, not stability.
Fewer bins isn't more accurate — what matters is keeping binning consistent, and PSI works on categorical features too, not just continuous.

scenario: 要给不同类型特征选漂移检测方法:一批是分箱后的类别/离散特征,一批是纯连续特征。
scenario_en: Choosing a drift test per feature type: some are binned categorical/discrete, others are purely continuous.
q: PSI 和 KS 检验各更适合哪类特征，输出和阈值有何不同？
q_en: Which feature types suit PSI vs the KS test, and how do their outputs and thresholds differ?
why: PSI 靠分箱,对类别与离散特征友好但对分箱敏感;KS 不用分箱,直接比两条 CDF 的最大距离,更适合连续特征。选型看特征类型:类别用 PSI,连续用 KS。
why_en: PSI relies on binning, suits categorical and binned continuous features, outputs a PSI score with 0.1/0.25 thresholds, and is cheap but bin-sensitive; the KS test needs no binning, compares two CDFs' max distance, suits continuous features, outputs a D-statistic plus p-value (p<0.05 significant), but is weak on high-dim/categorical.
tradeoff: PSI(分箱、类别友好、对分箱敏感) vs KS(无分箱、连续友好、类别差)
options: PSI 适合连续特征、KS 适合类别特征,两者输出都是 p 值,共用同一套阈值判断
两者完全等价,任何特征类型都能随意互换,输出含义与阈值也一样
PSI:分箱、类别友好、对分箱敏感;KS:无分箱、连续友好、输出 D 统计+p 值
KS 检验必须有真值标签才能跑,PSI 不需要,所以 KS 只能离线事后用
options_en: PSI suits continuous features and KS suits categorical ones, and both output p-values judged against one shared threshold.
They are fully equivalent, interchangeable on any feature type, with the same outputs and thresholds.
PSI is binned, categorical-friendly and bin-sensitive; KS is binning-free, continuous-friendly and outputs a D-stat plus p-value.
The KS test needs ground-truth labels to run while PSI does not, so KS is only usable offline after the fact.
optionExplanations: 说反了:PSI 靠分箱、对类别更友好,KS 无分箱、对连续更友好;且 PSI 输出的是分数不是 p 值。
不等价:适用特征类型、输出、对分箱的敏感度都不同,不能随意互换。
对;分箱与否决定了各自的适用特征和输出形态,这是选型的核心判据。
两者都是无标签的输入分布检测,KS 并不需要标签。
optionExplanations_en: Backwards: PSI relies on binning and is categorical-friendly while KS is binning-free and continuous-friendly, and PSI outputs a score, not a p-value.
Not equivalent: applicable feature types, outputs, and bin sensitivity all differ, so they are not interchangeable.
Correct — whether or not you bin determines each one's suitable features and output form, the core selection criterion.
Both are label-free input-distribution tests; KS does not need labels.

termDefinitions.meaning: 非参数检验,取两条累积分布函数(CDF)的最大距离为 D 统计量,配 p 值判显著。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The KS (Kolmogorov-Smirnov) test is nonparametric, taking the max distance between two CDFs as the D-statistic with a p-value for significance.

termDefinitions.meaning: 累积分布函数:某值以下的累计概率,KS 检验比较两条 CDF。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A CDF (Cumulative Distribution Function) gives the cumulative probability up to a value; the KS test compares two CDFs.

scenario: 两个团队用 PSI 监控同一个连续特征,一个分 5 箱、一个分 50 箱,算出的 PSI 差异很大。
scenario_en: Two teams monitor the same continuous feature with PSI, one with 5 bins and one with 50 bins, and get very different PSI values.
q: 这暴露了 PSI 的什么局限，怎么应对？
q_en: What PSI limitation does this expose, and how do you handle it?
why: PSI 对分箱选择敏感:箱数/边界变了,同一分布能算出不同 PSI,阈值判断随之飘。应对是固定分箱方案、对连续特征改用无需分箱的 KS 检验,并跨时间保持分箱一致以便可比。
why_en: PSI is sensitive to bin choice: changing bin count or edges yields different PSI for the same distribution, so fix the binning scheme, prefer the binning-free KS test for continuous features, and keep bins consistent over time for comparability.
options: PSI 对分箱敏感:箱数/边界一变,同分布算出不同 PSI;应固定分箱或改用 KS
说明 PSI 在任何场景下都不可用,应彻底弃用漂移检测,只靠在线精度掉了再回头查
说明箱越多一定越准,两队统一都分成 50 箱就能消掉这个差异
PSI 与分箱方案无关,两队结果不同只可能是取数或口径上的 bug
options_en: PSI is bin-sensitive: change bin count or edges and the same distribution yields a different PSI, so pin the binning or switch to KS.
It shows PSI is unusable in every setting, so drop drift detection entirely and just investigate after online accuracy falls.
It shows more bins are always more accurate, so having both teams use 50 bins removes the gap.
PSI does not depend on binning, so the gap can only come from a data-pull or definition bug.
optionExplanations: 对;分箱敏感是 PSI 的已知局限,固定分箱+对连续特征用 KS 是标准应对。
PSI 仍是低成本的类别/分箱漂移利器,只需固定分箱,不必彻底弃用。
箱越多不必然越准,反而更易受采样噪声影响,关键是跨时间一致。
差异恰恰来自分箱不同,不是数据 bug,这正是分箱敏感的表现。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — bin sensitivity is a known PSI limitation, and fixing bins plus using KS for continuous features is the standard remedy.
PSI is still a cheap tool for categorical/binned drift; just fix the binning rather than abandoning it.
More bins are not necessarily more accurate and can amplify sampling noise; consistency over time is what matters.
The difference comes precisely from different binning, not a data bug — that is the bin-sensitivity showing.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把连续值切成若干区间统计频率;PSI 依赖分箱,箱的选择会影响结果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Binning slices continuous values into intervals to count frequencies; PSI depends on binning and the bin choice affects the result.

scenario: 模型有上千个特征,对每个特征都跑昂贵的漂移检验、还高频跑,监控成本快赶上服务成本了。
scenario_en: The model has thousands of features, and running an expensive drift test on every one at high frequency makes monitoring cost rival serving cost.
q: 怎么在不留盲区的前提下压低监控成本？
q_en: How do you cut monitoring cost without leaving blind spots?
why: 只重点监控一小撮高重要度特征(按 SHAP/特征重要度选 top),并先用轻量汇总统计(mean/var/min/max)做粗筛,再对可疑特征上昂贵的逐特征检验。这样把算力花在最可能影响输出的特征上。
why_en: Monitor a curated set of high-importance features (top by SHAP/importance) and use lightweight summary stats (mean/var/min/max) as a first pass before expensive per-feature tests, spending compute on the features most likely to move the output.
tradeoff: 重点监控高重要度特征+轻量粗筛(省算力但可能漏低重要度特征) vs 全特征高频检验(无盲区但贵)
options: 对全部上千特征都跑最贵的逐特征检验,覆盖越全盲区就越少
只监控高重要度特征(SHAP top),先用轻量汇总统计粗筛再上贵检验
干脆不监控特征,等用户投诉或在线指标掉下来了再回头排查
随机抽 10 个特征监控,完全不看重要度,只求抽样成本可控、覆盖面看似公平
options_en: Run the most expensive per-feature test on all thousand-plus features, since fuller coverage means fewer blind spots.
Monitor only high-importance features by SHAP, screen with lightweight summary stats first, then run expensive tests on suspects.
Skip feature monitoring altogether and investigate once users complain or online metrics drop.
Randomly sample ten features with no regard to importance at all, just to keep cost bounded and coverage looking fair.
whenOtherWins: 若某个低重要度特征其实是已知易坏的上游管线来源,也该单独纳入监控,重要度不是唯一筛选维度。
whenOtherWins_en: If a low-importance feature comes from a known-fragile upstream pipeline, monitor it too — importance is not the only screening dimension.
optionExplanations: 全特征最贵检验成本失控,且大量低重要度特征漂了也不影响输出,性价比极低。
对;按重要度聚焦+轻量粗筛把算力花在刀刃上,兼顾覆盖与成本。
不监控等投诉是把退化外包给用户,发现时已造成损害。
随机抽样忽略重要度,可能全抽到无关特征、漏掉真正影响输出的那些。
optionExplanations_en: The most expensive test on all features blows up cost, and many low-importance features drifting does not move the output, so the ROI is terrible.
Correct — focus by importance plus a lightweight first pass spends compute where it counts, balancing coverage and cost.
Waiting for complaints outsources degradation detection to users, by which point damage is done.
Random sampling ignores importance and may pick all irrelevant features, missing the ones that actually move the output.

termDefinitions.meaning: 基于博弈论 Shapley 值的特征重要度归因,用来挑出对预测影响最大的特征。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) attributes feature importance via game-theoretic Shapley values, used to pick the features most influencing predictions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 均值/方差/最小/最大等轻量指标,作漂移的第一道粗筛。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Summary stats like mean/variance/min/max are lightweight measures used as a first-pass drift screen.

scenario: UI 改版后,同一批用户看同一个广告,特征分布几乎没变,但 CTR 却明显掉了。
scenario_en: After a UI redesign, the same users see the same ad with almost unchanged feature distributions, yet CTR clearly drops.
q: 这属于哪种漂移，为什么数据漂移检测抓不到它？
q_en: Which drift is this, and why do data-drift detectors miss it?
why: 这是概念漂移:特征看着一样,但输入→标签的映射 P(Y|X) 变了(改版后同样的展示不再引来点击)。PSI/KS 只比输入分布,输入没变它们无感,得靠标签驱动的信号(在线指标下降、残差/校准变化)才能抓。
why_en: This is concept drift: features look the same but the input-to-label mapping P(Y|X) changed (the same impression no longer draws a click), and since PSI/KS only compare inputs they miss it — you need label-driven signals.
tradeoff: 概念漂移(映射变、需标签抓) vs 数据漂移(输入变、比分布抓)
options: 数据漂移;输入分布确实变了,PSI 逐特征比对就能直接抓到
概念漂移;映射 P(Y|X) 变而输入未变,PSI/KS 只比输入故无感
预测漂移;这只是模型输出分布本身在随时间抖动,跟输入到标签的映射变化没有关系
标签延迟;映射其实没变,只是真标签迟到导致指标看起来滞后
options_en: Data drift; the input distribution really did move, so per-feature PSI catches it directly.
Concept drift; P(Y|X) changed while inputs did not, and PSI or KS only compare inputs so they stay blind.
Prediction drift; the output distribution is just jittering over time on its own, with nothing to do with a change in the input-to-label mapping.
Label delay; the mapping is unchanged and metrics only look stale because true labels arrive late.
whenOtherWins: 若是输入特征分布本身变了(如流量季节性),那才是数据漂移,PSI/KS 逐特征比分布就能抓到。
whenOtherWins_en: If the input feature distribution itself changed (seasonal traffic), that is data drift, caught by per-feature PSI/KS.
optionExplanations: PSI 只比输入分布,本题输入没变,它必然抓不到,判成数据漂移是典型误区。
对;映射变而输入不变正是概念漂移,只能靠标签相关信号发现。
预测漂移看输出分布,而本题根因是映射关系变,概念漂移更准确。
标签延迟是标签迟到的时效问题,与本题「映射变了」不是一回事。
optionExplanations_en: PSI only compares inputs; with inputs unchanged it necessarily misses this, so calling it data drift is a classic mistake.
Correct — a changed mapping with unchanged inputs is exactly concept drift, detectable only via label-related signals.
Prediction drift watches output distribution, but the root cause here is a changed mapping, so concept drift is more precise.
Label delay is a timing issue of late labels, different from the mapping changing here.

termDefinitions.meaning: 特征不变但输入到标签的映射 P(Y|X) 变了,同样输入现在对应不同结果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Concept drift is when features stay but the input-to-label mapping P(Y|X) changes, so the same input now yields a different outcome.

scenario: 你想直接确认概念漂移,手上有一部分已打标的生产数据。
scenario_en: You want to directly confirm concept drift and have some labeled production data on hand.
q: 检测概念漂移最直接的信号是什么，主要瓶颈是什么？
q_en: What is the most direct signal for concept drift, and what is the main bottleneck?
why: 最直接信号是在已打标生产数据上的在线指标(precision/recall/AUC)下降——映射真变了准确率就掉。瓶颈是标签延迟:欺诈标签要数周才确认,等真标签到手模型早已退化,所以常需代理信号顶上。
why_en: The most direct signal is a drop in online metrics (precision/recall/AUC) on labeled production data, but the bottleneck is label delay — fraud labels take weeks — so proxy signals often fill the gap.
options: 在已打标生产数据上的在线指标(precision/recall/AUC)下降;瓶颈是标签延迟
输入 PSI 上升信号最直接;它完全不依赖任何标签,所以概念漂移检测理论上也不存在延迟瓶颈这回事
GPU 利用率下降最直接;与标签完全无关,瓶颈在算力监控的采样率
模型文件体积变化最直接;不依赖任何标签,因此这条路径没有瓶颈
options_en: A drop in online metrics like precision, recall or AUC on labeled production data; the bottleneck is label delay.
A rising input PSI signal is the most direct one, and since it needs no labels at all, concept-drift detection in theory has no delay bottleneck at all.
Falling GPU utilization is the most direct signal, unrelated to labels, bottlenecked by the compute sampling rate.
A change in model file size is the most direct signal, needs no labels at all, so this path has no bottleneck.
optionExplanations: 对;标签驱动的在线指标下降最能证实映射变了,但真标签迟到是它的天然瓶颈。
输入 PSI 抓的是数据漂移;概念漂移里输入没变,PSI 无感,且这不是最直接的映射信号。
GPU 利用率是资源指标,跟映射 P(Y·X) 是否变化毫无关系。
模型体积不变,更与概念漂移无关,属无意义选项。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — a label-driven drop in online metrics best confirms a changed mapping, but late true labels are its inherent bottleneck.
Input PSI catches data drift; in concept drift inputs are unchanged so PSI is blind, and it is not the most direct mapping signal.
GPU utilization is a resource metric with nothing to do with whether P(Y|X) changed.
Model size does not change and is unrelated to concept drift, a meaningless option.

termDefinitions.meaning: ROC 曲线下面积,衡量分类器排序好坏,常用作在线监控指标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: AUC (Area Under the ROC Curve) measures a classifier's ranking quality and is a common online monitoring metric.

scenario: 标签要数周才到,你没法等真标签算在线精度,但又想尽早发现概念漂移。
scenario_en: Labels take weeks to arrive so you cannot wait for online accuracy, yet you want early warning of concept drift.
q: 标签滞后时，可以用哪些代理信号提示概念漂移？(多选)
q_en: When labels lag, which proxy signals hint at concept drift? (multiple)
why: 标签没到齐时用三类代理:残差分布监控(预测误差系统性偏移)、校准曲线分析(预测 30% 实测漂到 15%)、预测 vs 实际标签分布随真值陆续到来的分歧增长。它们比真标签更早给出映射变了的线索。
why_en: While labels lag, use residual-distribution monitoring (systematic error shift), calibration-curve analysis (predicts 30% but observed drifts to 15%), and growing divergence between predicted and actual label distributions as ground truth trickles in.
options: 残差分布监控:预测误差随时间系统性偏移
校准曲线分析:预测 30% 但实测漂到 15%
预测 vs 实际标签分布的分歧随真值陆续到来而增长
监控 GPU 温度是否升高
options_en: Residual-distribution monitoring: prediction errors systematically shift over time.
Calibration-curve analysis: predicts 30% but observed drifts to 15%.
Growing divergence between predicted and actual label distributions as ground truth arrives.
Monitoring whether GPU temperature rises.
optionExplanations: 对;残差系统性偏移(如持续高估)说明映射断了,不必等全部真标签。
对;校准漂移(预测概率与实测频率脱节)是概念漂移的早期信号。
对;随真值陆续到来两分布分歧变大,是强指示信号。
错;GPU 温度是硬件指标,与映射 P(Y·X) 是否变化无关。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — a systematic residual shift (e.g. consistent over-prediction) signals a broken mapping without waiting for all true labels.
Correct — calibration drift (predicted probabilities detaching from observed frequency) is an early concept-drift signal.
Correct — widening divergence between the two distributions as ground truth arrives is a strong indicator.
Wrong — GPU temperature is a hardware metric, unrelated to whether P(Y|X) changed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 预测值与真实值之差;其分布系统性偏移提示映射变化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A residual is the gap between prediction and actual; a systematic shift in its distribution hints at a changed mapping.

termDefinitions.meaning: 预测概率 vs 实际发生频率的关系曲线;两者脱节即校准退化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A calibration curve plots predicted probability against actual observed frequency; a gap between them means degraded calibration.

scenario: 一个分类模型对某类样本一直预测「30% 概率」,但随时间推移这类样本的实际发生率跌到了 15%。
scenario_en: A classifier keeps predicting '30% probability' for a class, but over time the actual rate for that class drifts to 15%.
q: 这说明模型出了什么问题，属于哪种监控信号？
q_en: What does this indicate about the model, and which monitoring signal is it?
why: 预测概率(30%)与实测频率(15%)持续脱节 = 校准退化,是概念漂移的代理信号:映射变了,模型的概率不再可信。后果是依赖该概率做阈值决策(如风控放行线)会系统性偏,需重训或重新校准。
why_en: A persistent gap between predicted probability (30%) and observed frequency (15%) is degraded calibration — a concept-drift proxy — meaning the mapping changed and the model's probabilities are no longer trustworthy.
options: 模型延迟变高了,属于服务性能监控,与预测概率准不准没有关系
校准退化:预测概率与实测频率脱节,是概念漂移代理信号,阈值决策会偏
输入分布变了,属于数据漂移,用 PSI 逐特征比对就能定位并修好
只是随机噪声,预测概率与实际频率本来就不必一致,不需要处理
options_en: Model latency went up, a service-performance issue with nothing to do with how accurate the predicted probability is.
Calibration decay: predicted probability has detached from observed frequency, a concept-drift proxy that skews threshold decisions.
The input distribution changed, so it is data drift and per-feature PSI will locate and fix it.
It is just random noise; predicted probability never has to match observed frequency, so no action is needed.
optionExplanations: 延迟是服务性能,与预测概率和实测频率脱节这个校准问题无关。
对;概率与频率脱节就是校准退化,作为概念漂移代理,会让所有基于该概率的阈值决策偏移。
PSI 查输入分布;这里问题在输出概率与真实频率的一致性,不是输入漂移。
持续单向脱节不是随机噪声,而是校准系统性退化,必须处理。
optionExplanations_en: Latency is serving performance, unrelated to the calibration gap between predicted probability and observed frequency.
Correct — probability detaching from frequency is degraded calibration, a concept-drift proxy that skews every threshold decision built on that probability.
PSI checks input distribution; here the issue is output-probability vs actual-frequency consistency, not input drift.
A persistent one-directional gap is not random noise but systematic calibration decay that must be addressed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型输出的概率与真实发生频率是否一致;预测 30% 就应约 30% 发生。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Calibration is whether the model's output probabilities match real frequencies; a predicted 30% should occur about 30% of the time.

scenario: 标签要数周才回来,你想要一条尽可能快、不依赖真值的退化「跳闸线」。
scenario_en: Labels return weeks later and you want the fastest possible degradation tripwire that needs no ground truth.
q: 哪种监控能不等标签就最快报警，代价是什么？
q_en: Which monitoring alerts fastest without labels, and at what cost?
why: 预测监控:只看模型输出分布随时间的变化,不需要任何真值标签,所以是最快的跳闸线。代价是它只报症状不报根因——输出突变可能来自数据漂移、概念漂移、管线 bug 或特征陈旧,还得进一步定位。
why_en: Prediction monitoring watches the output distribution over time with no ground-truth labels, making it the fastest tripwire, at the cost of flagging symptoms not root cause — an output shift could be data drift, concept drift, a pipeline bug, or stale features.
tradeoff: 预测监控(无标签、最快但只报症状) vs 在线指标(需标签、慢但直指映射)
options: 在线精度监控;它最快而且能直接定位根因,不受标签延迟影响
概念漂移检测;它不需要任何标签,靠输入分布就能确认映射变了
预测监控:只看输出分布、无需真值,最快;代价是只报症状
数据漂移 PSI;它可以替代真值标签,直接拿来评估模型的精度
options_en: Online accuracy monitoring; it is the fastest and pinpoints root cause, and label delay does not affect it.
Concept-drift detection; it needs no labels and confirms a mapping change from the input distribution alone.
Prediction monitoring: output distribution only, no ground truth, the fastest tripwire, but it reports symptoms only.
Data-drift PSI; it can stand in for ground-truth labels and directly measure model accuracy.
whenOtherWins: 当真标签能快速到手时,直接看在线精度/召回下降更能定位根因,不必只依赖预测分布这种症状信号。
whenOtherWins_en: When true labels arrive fast, a drop in online precision/recall pinpoints root cause better, so you need not rely only on the symptom-level prediction distribution.
optionExplanations: 在线精度要等真标签,恰恰不快;它准但慢,不满足「不等标签最快报警」。
概念漂移的最直接信号仍是标签驱动的在线指标,不是无标签就最快的那条。
对;输出分布监控无需标签、反应最快,但只能报症状,根因还得进一步查。
PSI 查的是输入漂移,不能替代真值评估模型精度。
optionExplanations_en: Online accuracy waits for true labels and is precisely not fast; it is accurate but slow, failing the label-free fastest-alert goal.
Concept drift's most direct signal is still label-driven online metrics, not the label-free fastest one.
Correct — output-distribution monitoring needs no labels and reacts fastest, but flags only symptoms with root cause needing further investigation.
PSI checks input drift and cannot replace ground truth for evaluating model accuracy.

termDefinitions.meaning: 跟踪模型输出分布随时间的变化并在偏离时报警,无需真值标签。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Prediction monitoring tracks the model's output distribution over time and alerts on divergence, needing no ground-truth labels.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一触即发的快速报警阈值,用于第一时间发现异常。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A tripwire is a fast trigger threshold that fires immediately to surface anomalies first.

scenario: 欺诈模型预测的欺诈率一夜之间从 3% 跳到 18%,但监控中的那些特征都没有数据漂移。
scenario_en: A fraud model's predicted fraud rate jumps from 3% to 18% overnight, yet none of the monitored features show data drift.
q: 预测分布突变但监控特征无漂移，最可能的根因是什么？
q_en: Prediction distribution shifted but monitored features show no drift — what is the most likely root cause?
why: 输出分布突变+被监控特征无漂移,强烈指向未被监控特征上的管线 bug:某个没在监控里的特征被喂了错误值,污染了预测。要去查特征管线健康度,而不是急着再训练。
why_en: An output shift with no drift in monitored features strongly points to a pipeline bug in an unmonitored feature serving wrong values, so investigate feature-pipeline health rather than rushing to retrain.
tradeoff: 先查未监控特征的管线 bug(常见根因) vs 直接再训练(可能白训还留着 bug)
options: 立刻全量再训练模型,不必查特征;重训会自动覆盖掉那些坏输入
某个未监控特征的管线 bug 喂了错值污染预测;先查特征管线健康度
一定是概念漂移,映射变了,而输入没变所以被监控特征才没反应
一定是数据漂移,只是 PSI 的分箱没算对,才漏掉了真正变化的特征
options_en: Retrain the whole model right away without checking features, since retraining will absorb the bad inputs.
A pipeline bug on an unmonitored feature is serving wrong values and polluting predictions; check feature-pipeline health first.
It must be concept drift: the mapping moved while inputs did not, which is why monitored features look calm.
It must be data drift, and PSI simply used the wrong bins, so it missed the features that actually moved.
whenOtherWins: 若排查后发现被监控特征确实也漂了,才转向数据漂移/概念漂移路线;先验证管线再谈重训。
whenOtherWins_en: Only if investigation shows monitored features did drift do you switch to a data/concept-drift track; verify the pipeline before retraining.
optionExplanations: 急着重训会在带 bug 的脏特征上训练,既浪费又治标不治本,根因还在。
对;监控特征无漂移却输出突变,典型是未监控特征的管线故障,先查管线最省事。
概念漂移一般不会一夜从 3% 跳到 18% 且监控特征全无漂移,更像管线突发故障。
监控特征无漂移不支持数据漂移结论;把它归为 PSI 算错缺乏依据。
optionExplanations_en: Rushing to retrain trains on buggy dirty features, wasteful and treating symptoms while the root cause remains.
Correct — no drift in monitored features but a sudden output shift is classically an unmonitored-feature pipeline fault, so check the pipeline first.
Concept drift rarely jumps 3% to 18% overnight with zero drift in monitored features; a sudden pipeline fault is likelier.
No drift in monitored features does not support a data-drift conclusion, and blaming a PSI miscalculation lacks basis.

termDefinitions.term: feature pipeline bug / 特征管线 bug
termDefinitions.meaning: 计算或传输某特征的管线出错,给模型喂了错误值,常在未监控特征上。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A feature-pipeline bug is a fault in computing or delivering a feature that feeds the model wrong values, often on unmonitored features.

scenario: 对比「预测监控」和「概念漂移检测」在是否需要标签、速度、能否定位根因上的差别。
scenario_en: Compare prediction monitoring and concept-drift detection on label need, speed, and root-cause localization.
q: 预测监控与概念漂移检测最关键的两点差别是什么？
q_en: What are the two key differences between prediction monitoring and concept-drift detection?
why: 预测监控无需标签、最快,但只报症状(输出变了)不指根因;概念漂移检测(靠在线指标/残差/校准)需要标签或代理,慢一些,但直指映射真的变了。两者互补:预测监控先跳闸,概念漂移检测再定性。
why_en: Prediction monitoring needs no labels and is fastest but flags only symptoms, while concept-drift detection (via online metrics/residuals/calibration) needs labels or proxies and is slower but points at a real mapping change — they are complementary.
tradeoff: 预测监控(无标签、快、只报症状) vs 概念漂移检测(需标签、慢、指根因)
options: 两者都需要标签,速度也差不多,区别只在于用的统计算法名字不同
预测监控慢但准而且能定根因,概念漂移检测快但结论不太可靠
预测监控无标签、最快但只报症状;概念漂移检测需标签、慢但指根因
预测监控只能用在分类模型上,概念漂移检测只能用在回归模型上
options_en: Both need labels and run at similar speed; the only difference is the name of the statistic used.
Prediction monitoring is slow but accurate and pinpoints root cause, while concept-drift detection is fast but unreliable.
Prediction monitoring is label-free and fastest but symptoms-only; concept-drift detection needs labels, is slower, but names the cause.
Prediction monitoring only applies to classification models and concept-drift detection only to regression models.
optionExplanations: 预测监控恰恰不需要标签,这正是它快的原因,说两者都需标签是错的。
说反了:预测监控快但只报症状,概念漂移检测慢但更能定性根因。
对;是否需标签+能否定位根因是两者互补的核心分工。
两者都能用于分类和回归,只是统计量不同,不受任务类型限制。
optionExplanations_en: Prediction monitoring precisely needs no labels, which is why it is fast, so saying both need labels is wrong.
Backwards: prediction monitoring is fast but symptoms-only, while concept-drift detection is slower but better at root cause.
Correct — label need plus root-cause capability is the complementary division of labor between them.
Both apply to classification and regression with different statistics, not restricted by task type.

termDefinitions.term: symptom vs root cause / 症状 vs 根因
termDefinitions.meaning: 症状是可观测的异常(输出变了),根因是背后原因(漂移/bug/陈旧);监控要从症状追到根因。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A symptom is an observable anomaly (output shifted) while the root cause is the underlying reason (drift/bug/staleness); monitoring traces from symptom to root cause.

scenario: 值班工程师每天被上百条告警淹没,慢慢开始忽略它们,结果真出事那次也被划过去了。
scenario_en: On-call engineers are flooded with hundreds of alerts daily, start ignoring them, and swipe past the one time it really mattered.
q: 告警设计的首要失败模式是什么，怎么防？
q_en: What is alerting's primary failure mode, and how do you guard against it?
why: 首要失败模式是告警疲劳(alert fatigue),而非漏报:告警太多、太吵,人就麻木、把真信号一起忽略。防法是分严重度分级(page/小时级/日报),让每条告警的动作明确、噪声可控。
why_en: The primary failure mode is alert fatigue, not missed signals: too many noisy alerts numb people into ignoring real ones, guarded against with severity tiers (page/within-hours/daily digest) so each alert has a clear action.
options: 漏报;应该把所有阈值都调到最敏感,宁可多报也绝不能放过真信号
告警延迟;只要加快推送通道、缩短采集间隔,值班人自然就能第一时间及时响应
告警疲劳(太吵致麻木);用严重度分级(page/小时级/日报)让动作明确
告警存储成本;把历史告警日志压缩归档,成本降下来问题自然就没了
options_en: Missed detections; set every threshold to maximum sensitivity so no real signal ever slips through.
Alert latency; just speed up the push channel and shorten the collection interval and on-call will naturally respond in time.
Alert fatigue from too much noise; tier alerts by severity (page / within hours / daily digest) so each has a clear action.
Alert storage cost; compress and archive historical alert logs and the problem goes away once cost drops.
optionExplanations: 把阈值全调最敏感恰恰制造告警疲劳,真信号会被海量误报淹没,适得其反。
推送再快,若量大而杂,人依旧麻木,速度不是根本问题。
对;告警疲劳是首要敌人,分级让高危立即 page、低危进日报,噪声可控。
存储成本是次要工程问题,与人会不会忽略告警的可用性无关。
optionExplanations_en: Making all thresholds most sensitive precisely creates alert fatigue, drowning real signals in false alarms — counterproductive.
Faster pushing does not help if volume is high and noisy; people still go numb, and speed is not the core issue.
Correct — alert fatigue is the primary enemy, and tiering pages high-severity immediately while sending low-severity to a digest keeps noise controlled.
Storage cost is a minor engineering issue, unrelated to whether people ignore alerts.

termDefinitions.meaning: 告警过多过吵导致值班人麻木、忽略,连真信号也被划过。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Alert fatigue is when too many noisy alerts numb on-call staff into ignoring them, including real signals.

scenario: 线上突然出现:模型对所有请求都吐同一个常数输出(预测分布塌缩),用户正在受影响。
scenario_en: In production the model suddenly emits a constant output for every request (prediction distribution collapse) and users are affected right now.
q: 这该归到哪个告警严重度层，为什么？
q_en: Which severity tier does this belong to, and why?
why: 预测分布塌缩(常数输出)=系统实质已坏、正在伤用户,属 Tier 1「立即 page」,和服务报错、延迟 SLA 违约同级。这类要人马上响应,不能等日报。
why_en: Prediction distribution collapse (constant output) means the system is effectively broken and hurting users now, so it is Tier 1 'page immediately,' alongside serving errors and latency SLA breaches.
tradeoff: Tier 1 立即 page(系统正在坏) vs Tier 2/3(退化但仍可用)
options: Tier 3 日报:属于信息性观察,汇总进日报、留到周会复盘就够了
Tier 2 小时级:功能其实还在只是退化,几个小时内处理来得及
Tier 1 立即 page:预测塌缩=系统实质已坏、正在伤用户
根本不用告警:常数输出多半会随着流量变化自己恢复正常
options_en: Tier 3 daily digest: this is informational, roll it into the daily report and review it at the weekly meeting.
Tier 2 within hours: the feature still works and is merely degrading, so handling it within a few hours is fine.
Tier 1 page immediately: a collapsed prediction distribution means the system is effectively broken and hurting users.
No alert at all: a constant output usually recovers on its own as traffic patterns shift.
whenOtherWins: 若只是高重要度特征出现显著漂移但输出仍正常、用户暂未受影响,那降到 Tier 2 小时级告警即可。
whenOtherWins_en: If only a high-importance feature shows significant drift while outputs stay normal and users are not yet affected, drop to a Tier 2 within-hours alert.
optionExplanations: 常数输出正在伤用户,放日报等于故障持续几天,严重误判等级。
系统已实质失效不是「仍在只是退化」,Tier 2 低估了严重性。
对;塌缩=正在坏、正在伤用户,和服务报错/延迟违约同属立即 page。
模型不会自愈常数输出这种故障,不告警会让事故无人处理。
optionExplanations_en: Constant output is hurting users now; a daily digest means the outage lasts days — a severe misgrading.
The system is effectively down, not 'still functional just degrading,' so Tier 2 underrates the severity.
Correct — collapse means actively broken and harming users, so it is page-immediately alongside serving errors and latency breaches.
The model will not self-heal a constant-output fault; not alerting leaves the incident unhandled.

termDefinitions.term: prediction distribution collapse / 预测分布塌缩
termDefinitions.meaning: 模型对所有输入输出几乎相同的常数,输出多样性消失,常是严重故障。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Prediction distribution collapse is when the model emits nearly the same constant for all inputs, losing output diversity — usually a severe fault.

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务水平协议:承诺的延迟/可用性等指标上限,违约即触发高优告警。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An SLA (Service Level Agreement) is a committed bound on latency/availability whose breach triggers a high-priority alert.

scenario: 一个高重要度特征的 PSI 突破 0.25、在线指标也跌过阈值,但服务没报错、输出还正常,用户暂时没受明显影响。
scenario_en: A high-importance feature's PSI crosses 0.25 and an online metric dips past threshold, but serving is fine and outputs normal, with no clear user impact yet.
q: 这该归到哪个告警层，为什么不是立即 page？
q_en: Which alert tier is this, and why not page immediately?
why: 显著数据漂移(高重要度特征 PSI>0.25)+在线指标退化,属「退化但仍可用」,归 Tier 2:小时级告警。它需要尽快处理但系统没崩,占用即时 page 反而制造告警疲劳。
why_en: Significant data drift (high-importance feature PSI>0.25) plus online-metric degradation is 'degrading but functional,' so it is Tier 2 within-hours — it needs prompt attention but the system is not down, and paging immediately would breed alert fatigue.
tradeoff: Tier 2 小时级(退化但可用) vs Tier 1 page(系统正在坏)
options: Tier 1 立即 page:任何特征越过 PSI 阈值都必须马上把值班人叫醒
Tier 2 小时级:显著漂移+指标退化属退化但仍可用,系统还没崩
Tier 3 日报:输出目前还正常,再显著的漂移也只能算信息性观察
不告警:PSI 只是个参考指标,等在线指标彻底崩了再处理也不迟
options_en: Tier 1 page immediately: any feature crossing its PSI threshold must wake on-call right away.
Tier 2 within hours: significant drift plus metric decay is degrading-but-usable, and the system has not gone down.
Tier 3 daily digest: output still looks fine, so even significant drift is only an informational observation.
No alert: PSI is only a reference number, and it is fine to wait until online metrics fully collapse.
whenOtherWins: 若这个漂移已导致输出塌缩或延迟 SLA 违约、用户正在受损,就升级到 Tier 1 立即 page。
whenOtherWins_en: If the drift has caused output collapse or a latency SLA breach with users being harmed, escalate to Tier 1 page immediately.
optionExplanations: 把所有漂移都设成立即 page 会制造告警疲劳,只有正在伤用户才配 Tier 1。
对;显著漂移+指标退化但系统仍可用,正是 Tier 2 小时级的定义。
显著数据漂移比日报级(轻微/陈旧)更急,放 Tier 3 会拖成大故障。
PSI>0.25 在高重要度特征上是明确行动信号,不能不告警。
optionExplanations_en: Making all drift page-immediately breeds alert fatigue; only active user harm warrants Tier 1.
Correct — significant drift plus metric degradation while the system stays usable is exactly the Tier 2 within-hours definition.
Significant data drift is more urgent than digest-level (minor/staleness); Tier 3 would let it fester into a big outage.
PSI>0.25 on a high-importance feature is a clear action signal that must be alerted.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按影响把告警分级(Tier 1 立即 page / Tier 2 小时级 / Tier 3 日报),控制噪声。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Severity tiers grade alerts by impact (Tier 1 page / Tier 2 within-hours / Tier 3 digest) to control noise.

scenario: 团队要决定「PSI 到多少才该告警」,有人想直接照搬教科书的 0.25,有人想按自己历史事故来定。
scenario_en: The team must decide 'at what PSI to alert,' with some wanting to copy the textbook 0.25 and others wanting to base it on their own past incidents.
q: 告警阈值最该怎么定？
q_en: How should alert thresholds be set?
why: 阈值要经验校准:回溯历史事故,看到底多大的漂移幅度才真正对应到用户可感的退化,再据此设阈值。照搬通用数字容易在你的业务上要么太吵、要么漏报。
why_en: Calibrate thresholds empirically: do a retrospective on past incidents to find what drift magnitude actually correlated with user-facing degradation, and set thresholds from that, since copying generic numbers is too noisy or too blind on your workload.
tradeoff: 经验校准阈值(贴合本业务) vs 照搬通用值(简单但常错配)
options: 直接照搬教科书的 0.25,它对所有系统都通用,不必看自家历史数据
经验校准:回溯历史事故,找出真正对应用户可感退化的漂移幅度
把阈值设到最敏感,宁可全报也不漏,噪声让值班人手工筛掉就行
阈值先随便设一个,反正上线之后总会凭手感不断往上往下调
options_en: Just copy the textbook 0.25; it is universal across systems and you need not look at your own history.
Calibrate empirically: replay past incidents to find the drift magnitude that actually tracked user-visible degradation.
Set thresholds to maximum sensitivity, over-alert rather than miss, and let on-call filter the noise by hand.
Pick any threshold to start, since you will keep nudging it up and down by feel after launch anyway.
whenOtherWins: 冷启动、还没有历史事故数据时,可先用 0.25 等通用值当起点,积累事故后再用经验值替换。
whenOtherWins_en: On cold start with no incident history, start from a generic value like 0.25 and replace it with empirical thresholds once incidents accumulate.
optionExplanations: 通用 0.25 未必匹配你的特征与业务,照搬常导致要么太吵要么漏报。
对;用历史事故反推「多大漂移=真退化」,阈值才贴合本业务,既不吵也不漏。
最敏感阈值制造海量误报,正是告警疲劳的根源。
随机阈值没有依据,会长期在误报和漏报之间乱跳。
optionExplanations_en: A generic 0.25 may not match your features and business, so copying it tends to be too noisy or too blind.
Correct — inferring 'what drift equals real degradation' from past incidents fits your workload, neither noisy nor blind.
The most sensitive threshold creates a flood of false alarms — the very source of alert fatigue.
Random thresholds have no basis and will swing between false alarms and misses for a long time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用历史事故的实际数据反推阈值,而非照搬通用默认值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Empirical calibration derives thresholds from real historical-incident data rather than copying generic defaults.

q: 告警响了,把 on-call 处置手册的四步排成正确顺序:
q_en: An alert fires — order the four on-call playbook steps correctly:
steps: 核实告警不是误报:查管线健康、特征新鲜度、监控本身是否有 bug
评估爆炸半径:哪些分段、多少比例流量受影响
按严重度执行响应:紧急再训练 / 回滚到上个 champion / 启用兜底启发式
记录根因并更新阈值:每次事故回灌到监控配置
why: 顺序是先证真再评估影响、再动手、最后固化经验:①核实防止为误报瞎忙;②评估爆炸半径决定处置力度;③按严重度选再训练/回滚/降级;④把根因和新阈值写回配置,让下次更准。
why_en: The order is verify, assess impact, act, then institutionalize: confirm it is not a false positive, gauge blast radius to size the response, execute by severity (retrain/rollback/fallback), then document root cause and update thresholds so next time is sharper.
diagram:
flowchart TB V["1. 核实非误报"] --> B["2. 评估爆炸半径"] B --> E["3. 执行响应
再训练/回滚/降级"] E --> D["4. 记录根因+更新阈值"] D -.回灌.-> V

termDefinitions.term: on-call playbook / 值班处置手册
termDefinitions.meaning: 告警触发后逐步照做的标准流程:核实→评估→响应→复盘,减少现场判断失误。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An on-call playbook is a step-by-step standard procedure after an alert: verify, assess, respond, review — reducing on-the-spot mistakes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次故障影响到的分段和流量比例,决定该多用力处置。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Blast radius is the segments and traffic fraction a fault affects, sizing how forcefully to respond.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型不可用时退回的简单规则(如按热度排序),保证服务不彻底崩。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A fallback heuristic is a simple rule (e.g. popularity ranking) the system falls back to when the model is unusable, keeping service alive.

scenario: 告警确认为真、爆炸半径评估完毕,现在要选具体响应动作,严重度为「系统正在严重伤用户」。
scenario_en: The alert is confirmed real and blast radius assessed; now choose the response action, with severity 'the system is seriously harming users.'
q: on-call 手册第三步「执行响应」通常在哪几种动作里按严重度选？
q_en: The playbook's third step 'execute response' typically chooses among which actions by severity?
why: 第三步按严重度在三种动作里选:紧急再训练(有干净数据、时间允许)、回滚到上一个 champion(最快止血、恢复已知良好版本)、或启用兜底启发式(连回滚都不稳时保底可用)。严重伤用户时优先回滚/降级先止血。
why_en: Step three picks by severity among emergency retraining (clean data and time allow), rollback to the previous champion (fastest stop-loss to a known-good version), or activating a fallback heuristic (guarantee availability when even rollback is shaky); with serious user harm, roll back or degrade first to stop the bleeding.
tradeoff: 回滚/降级(最快止血) vs 紧急再训练(治本但慢,需干净数据)
options: 只有紧急再训练这一个动作:不管训练数据是否已被污染、也不考虑回滚,一律立刻重训
紧急再训练 / 回滚到上个 champion / 启用兜底启发式,按严重度选
只能等下一个调度周期再统一处理,不做任何即时的响应动作
直接关停整个服务,不提供降级或兜底,等彻底修好了再开回来
options_en: Only one action, emergency retraining: retrain immediately regardless of whether training data is polluted and without considering rollback.
Emergency retrain, rollback to the previous champion, or switch on a fallback heuristic, picked by severity.
Wait for the next scheduled cycle and handle it in batch, taking no immediate response action.
Shut the whole service down with no degraded mode or fallback, and bring it back only once fully fixed.
whenOtherWins: 若退化温和、且已有验证干净的新数据,可跳过回滚直接紧急再训练治本;止血优先只在严重伤用户时压倒治本。
whenOtherWins_en: If degradation is mild and clean new data is validated, skip rollback and retrain to fix the root cause; stop-loss-first only overrides root-cause fixing under serious user harm.
optionExplanations: 紧急再训练若在脏数据上做反而更糟,不能作为唯一动作,严重时更该先止血。
对;三选一按严重度定,严重伤用户时回滚/降级最快恢复已知良好状态。
严重事故等下个周期等于放任伤害,违背 on-call 即时响应的初衷。
关停服务比降级更伤用户,兜底启发式正是为避免彻底关停而设。
optionExplanations_en: Emergency retraining on dirty data makes it worse, so it cannot be the only action, and serious cases should stop-loss first.
Correct — pick one of three by severity, and with serious harm rollback/degrade fastest restores a known-good state.
Waiting for the next cycle during a serious incident lets harm continue, defeating on-call's immediate-response purpose.
Shutting down harms users more than degrading; a fallback heuristic exists precisely to avoid full shutdown.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把服务切回上一个已知良好的模型版本(上个 champion),最快止血。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Rollback switches serving back to the last known-good model version (the previous champion), the fastest stop-loss.

scenario: 面试官问你监控设计里最核心的取舍;你想给一句能收住全场、并说清怎么落地的话。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks the core tradeoff in your monitoring design and wants one closing line plus how you would implement it.
q: ML 监控的核心取舍是什么，最优做法是怎样落地的？
q_en: What is the core tradeoff in ML monitoring, and how does the optimal approach implement it?
why: 核心取舍是监控粒度 vs 运维成本:对每个特征高频跑昂贵统计是浪费,信号太少又留盲区。最优落地:重点监控高重要度特征、用预测分布当快速跳闸线、用历史事故经验校准告警阈值,把成本花在最能预警用户可感退化的地方。
why_en: The core tradeoff is monitoring granularity vs operational cost: expensive stats on every feature at high frequency is wasteful while too few signals leave blind spots, so the optimum monitors high-importance features, uses the prediction distribution as a fast tripwire, and calibrates thresholds empirically.
tradeoff: 监控粒度(覆盖全但贵) vs 运维成本(省钱但留盲区)
options: 核心取舍是精度 vs 召回,把决策阈值调一调即可,与监控成本无关
监控越多越好,只要算力买得够,根本不存在任何成本上的取舍
监控粒度 vs 运维成本:重点监控高重要度特征+预测分布当快跳闸线
核心取舍是 GPU vs CPU,选对推理硬件,监控开销自然就降下来了
options_en: The core tradeoff is precision versus recall; just move the decision threshold, and monitoring cost is not involved.
More monitoring is always better; buy enough compute and there is no cost tradeoff at all.
Monitoring granularity versus operational cost: watch high-importance features and use the prediction distribution as a fast tripwire.
The core tradeoff is GPU versus CPU; pick the right inference hardware and monitoring overhead drops by itself.
whenOtherWins: 若是高风险合规场景(如医疗/风控),可接受更高监控成本换取近乎全覆盖的粒度,天平偏向粒度而非省钱。
whenOtherWins_en: In high-stakes compliance settings (medical/risk), accept higher monitoring cost for near-full coverage, tilting toward granularity over savings.
optionExplanations: 精度/召回是模型评估指标,不是监控系统的成本-覆盖取舍。
监控有实打实的算力和维护成本,盲目全量监控不可持续,存在明确取舍。
对;粒度 vs 成本是核心轴,三招(重点特征+预测跳闸+经验阈值)把成本花在刀刃上。
GPU/CPU 是硬件选型,答不到监控覆盖与成本的系统级取舍。
optionExplanations_en: Precision/recall is a model-evaluation metric, not the cost-coverage tradeoff of a monitoring system.
Monitoring has real compute and maintenance cost, so blanket monitoring is unsustainable and a real tradeoff exists.
Correct — granularity vs cost is the core axis, and the three moves (key features, prediction tripwire, empirical thresholds) spend cost where it counts.
GPU/CPU is hardware selection and misses the system-level tradeoff of monitoring coverage vs cost.

termDefinitions.meaning: 监控覆盖多少特征、多高频率;越细越无盲区但成本越高。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Monitoring granularity is how many features and how often you monitor; finer means fewer blind spots but higher cost.

scenario: 复习 PSI 的三档阈值与各自动作。
scenario_en: Review PSI's three threshold bands and their actions.
q: 补全 PSI 的三档阈值与对应处置：
q_en: Fill in PSI's three threshold bands and their actions:
text: PSI 阈值:<{{0.1}} 视为无明显漂移;{{0.1–0.25}} 为中度漂移,需{{排查}};>{{0.25}} 为显著漂移,需{{采取行动}}(排查/再训练)。
text_en: PSI thresholds: <{{0.1}} means no meaningful shift; {{0.1-0.25}} is moderate drift needing {{investigation}}; >{{0.25}} is significant drift needing {{action}} (investigate/retrain).
why: PSI 三档是经验分级:<0.1 稳、0.1–0.25 中度先排查、>0.25 显著要行动。它把连续的漂移分数转成清晰的处置动作,也对应告警分级里 PSI>0.25 归 Tier 2。
why_en: PSI's three bands are an empirical grading: under 0.1 stable, 0.1 to 0.25 moderate-investigate, above 0.25 significant-act, mapping a continuous score to clear actions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 总体稳定性指数,衡量分布漂移;三档阈值 0.1/0.25 对应无/中度/显著。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PSI (Population Stability Index) measures distribution drift, with 0.1/0.25 bands for none/moderate/significant.

scenario: 回归型贷款违约模型,某天预测的平均违约率从 12% 跳到 40%。
scenario_en: A regression loan-default model sees its predicted average default rate jump from 12% to 40% one day.
q: 预测监控对回归模型看什么，这个突变说明什么、下一步该做什么？
q_en: What does prediction monitoring track for regression, what does this jump mean, and what next?
why: 回归型预测监控看输出的均值/方差/分位数随时间的变化。12%→40% 是输出分布突变,是症状不是根因:可能数据漂移、概念漂移、管线 bug 或特征陈旧。下一步先按 on-call 手册核实非误报、查未监控特征管线,再定性。
why_en: For regression, prediction monitoring tracks the output mean/variance/percentiles over time, and a 12% to 40% jump is a symptom not a root cause (data drift, concept drift, pipeline bug, or stale features), so next verify it is not a false positive and check unmonitored feature pipelines before diagnosing.
options: 看输出均值/方差/分位数;这是症状不是根因,先核实再查未监控管线
看输入 PSI;这种突变必然是数据漂移,直接触发一次全量再训练即可
看 GPU 利用率;突变说明算力不足,把推理节点扩容上去就会回落
看模型文件体积;突变说明参数损坏,回滚换一个模型文件就好了
options_en: Track output mean, variance and percentiles; this is a symptom not a cause, so verify it then check unmonitored pipelines.
Track input PSI; a jump like this has to be data drift, so just kick off a full retrain.
Track GPU utilization; the jump means not enough compute, and scaling out inference nodes will bring it back.
Track model file size; the jump means corrupted parameters, so roll back to another model file.
optionExplanations: 对;回归看均值/方差/分位数,输出突变只是症状,须按手册先证真、查管线再定根因。
预测监控看的是输出不是输入 PSI,且突变未必是数据漂移,直接再训练会跳过定位。
GPU 利用率是资源指标,和预测违约率的分布突变无关。
模型体积不变也与违约率突变无关,属无关项。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — regression tracks mean/variance/percentiles, an output jump is only a symptom, so verify and check pipelines before naming a root cause.
Prediction monitoring tracks outputs not input PSI, and the jump is not necessarily data drift, so retraining outright skips localization.
GPU utilization is a resource metric, unrelated to a distributional jump in predicted default rate.
Model size does not change and is unrelated to the default-rate jump, an irrelevant option.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型预测值的分布;分类看类概率/频率,回归看均值/方差/分位数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The output distribution is the spread of the model's predictions; classification tracks class probabilities/frequencies, regression tracks mean/variance/percentiles.
